title: Overview
summary: The home page: what needs your attention today, at a glance.

sections.title: What you see on the Overview

blocks.text: The Overview is the first page after you sign in. It shows small cards, one for each part of the app you can use. A card never shows anything you are not allowed to see.

items: **Add task**: a box at the top where you can type a task and press Enter. It appears only if you may add tasks.
**Due soon**: your own open tasks with a due date, late ones first, then the soonest. Press a task to open it.
**Upcoming occasions**: birthdays, name days and other occasions in the next 60 days, with a shortcut to the wishlist.
**Still to pay**: recurring bills that are due this month (only if you have finance access).
**Health**: a shortcut to open Health. It never shows any health details on the Overview (only if you have health access).
**System status**: when the app last checked itself in the background.

blocks.text: If a card is missing, you probably do not have access to that part of the app. Ask your administrator.
A new account may show few cards and short messages such as Nothing is due soon. That is normal. Add your first task or wish and the cards fill up.
